name: Trying My Best Is Very Hard
source:
Play as an art school student trying to get through the college semester. Make choices about friendships, classes and living alone that lead to different endings. Just try your best! 

[From [url=https://httpwhalien.itch.io/trying-my-best] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
扮演一名艺术学校的学生，努力度过大学学期。对友谊、阶级和独居做出选择，从而导致不同的结局。尽力而为吧！

[来自[url=https://httpwhalien.itch.io/trying-my-best] itch.io[/url]]
